color.note: Four themes, one per surface: paper is dorizza.com and the Resource covers; screen, raster and video are the three display technologies a video may use (tools/themes.json). One theme per video, screen by default. The constants at the end hold the same value in every theme.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground of every page and frame: the site's paper, or the video theme's flat field. Never textured, never a gradient.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: All type and every line that must read, on bg: 19.8:1 paper, 15.2:1 screen, 9.8:1 raster, 9.8:1 video.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: The theme's second tone, for shapes, not text: mascot side and tube, avatar discs, unlit caption words. On bg it measures 2.4:1 screen, 1.7:1 raster, 2.4:1 video, so no readable text in it there (the house comment card's 'Commenta…' placeholder misses at 2.4:1). Paper has no flat grey: there dim is ink, shown through a dither mask.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, midway between fg and dim (theme_kit.py MUTED): 6.8:1 screen, 5.2:1 video, 4.4:1 raster (24px and up only there). Paper: ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one signal, always a fill with on-accent on top. Paper: the sage of chips, the detection label, the button's square, link hover, panels; 1.4:1 on paper, so never a thin line or text there. Video: the solid bar the ground is knocked out of (lockup rows, the Segui button, terminal lines).

tokens.name: accent2
tokens.usage: A second highlight in video only (theme_kit.py accent2): dark LCD, pale amber, teletext cyan; on bg 5.7:1, 14.6:1, 11.1:1. Paper has one signal: there it is the sage.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Type and marks drawn on accent: ink on sage 14.4:1, sage on black 15.2:1, black on amber 9.8:1, blue on yellow 13.0:1.

tokens.name: caption-box
tokens.usage: The phrase caption's box over footage: the darker of bg and fg at 85% (hf_build.py). Unlit words sit in dim on it, the spoken word in on-footage.

tokens.name: on-footage
tokens.usage: Type over his footage: the lit caption word, the STEP line behind his head. The lighter of bg and fg (black vanished on his blurred room). On caption-box 15.2:1 screen, 9.8:1 raster, 9.8:1 video.

tokens.name: detect
tokens.usage: The Apple Vision face box and its label cell: the sage on paper (stroke-detect, 2px), the theme's bg over footage (stroke-card, 5px). The label's text is fg.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: dorizza.com's ground, fixed in every theme: share cards, Resource covers, the knock-out inside the halftone silhouette.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Press ink, fixed: type, halftone dots, rules and the drawn masthead on paper (19.8:1).

tokens.name: pale-sage
tokens.usage: The brand's one hue, fixed: the site's signal and the screen theme's LCD green are the same colour. A fill under ink; ink on it reads 14.4:1.

tokens.name: teletext-blue
tokens.usage: The video theme's ground, fixed, for pointing at the teletext look from another surface.

tokens.name: crt-amber
tokens.usage: The raster theme's ink, fixed, for pointing at the amber CRT look from another surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section headings on the site: clamp(2.75rem, 1.4rem + 4.6vw, 6rem), 96px at full width. Offer headings and work names go to -0.04em.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Secondary headings and card titles: clamp(1.625rem, 1.2rem + 1.2vw, 2.25rem).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Show the work, then explain it plainly.
styles.usage: The paragraph beside a section heading, 34 to 40ch: clamp(1.25rem, 1.05rem + 0.6vw, 1.5rem).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every credential links to something real: a live product, a repo, a paper.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Insegna qualsiasi cosa al tuo agente con i video di YouTube.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Notes, consent text; nav links at 15px, weight 500.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary button labels; the large button runs 17 to 21px.

styles.name: shout
styles.usage: The one shout on a Resource cover (1600x840 px), upper case, fitted to its width. Italian, 1 to 3 words, the reader's benefit.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Detection labels, years, ranks, outcome numbers, figure captions, with tabular figures: clamp(1rem, 0.9rem + 0.35vw, 1.375rem).

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chips: a live status or a Resource type.

styles.name: mark
styles.usage: The nav mark and the language switch.

styles.name: lockup-step
styles.usage: STEP lockups behind his head, 860 px wide. Every lockup row is sized by tools/lockup.py so the rows share one width; this is the STEP size.

styles.name: video-button
styles.usage: The Segui button: accent bar, on-accent text, 400x120.

styles.name: video-card
styles.usage: Text inside a comment card or reply card, 104 px tall.

styles.name: facebox-tag
styles.usage: The face box's label over footage.

styles.name: caption-phrase
styles.usage: Phrase captions, the only caption style since ai-websites: up to 4 words or about 20 characters, never under 48px.

spacing.note: dorizza.com's eight steps. Use only these on paper.

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: consent row gap, figure caption offset.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: Form gaps, callout padding, skip link inline padding.

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: Section head gap, callout inline padding.

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Gaps between rows of a group.

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: Gaps between groups.

tokens.name: s6
tokens.usage: Below a section head; a section's bottom padding.

tokens.name: s7
tokens.usage: A section's top padding.

tokens.name: s8
tokens.usage: The largest break.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side gutter: clamp(16px, 2.8vw, 40px), inside a 1520px frame.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: The fixed nav bar's height.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner: buttons, chips, inputs, panels, images, cards, lockup bars, video cards.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: The one round form: a halftone dot, a Matrix Sans dot, the avatar disc in a comment card.

shadow.note: The system is flat. A shadow is only a 1px line in disguise, or the video cover's hard plate.

tokens.name: shadow-line
tokens.usage: A 1px fg line drawn as an inset shadow: line chips, inline code, the progress bar's outline.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: The hard offset plate under a browser window on a video cover (ai-websites, screen). Paper never lifts anything; the other themes have no sourced plate yet.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: The structural line on paper: section rules, row dividers, ruled panels, inputs, link underlines.

tokens.name: stroke-detect
tokens.usage: Paper only: the detection stroke, the overlay card's top rule, the error frame.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus outline, fg, 3px offset (2px around form rows).

tokens.name: stroke-card
tokens.usage: Video: comment cards and the face box over footage.

tokens.name: stroke-cover
tokens.usage: Covers: the Resource covers' ink line and the video cover's browser window.

frame.note: The vertical master, 1080x1920 at 30fps, and the zones the platforms leave free.

tokens.name: frame-w
tokens.usage: Master width. One render serves Shorts, Reels and TikTok.

tokens.name: frame-h
tokens.usage: Master height. Never landscape, never letterboxed.

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: 0.12 H: nothing that must read sits above it.

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: 0.78 H: caption and card blocks end above it (platform captions, username).

tokens.name: rail-x
tokens.usage: 0.82 W: the right action rail starts here below about 0.45 H.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: 0.05 W: side gutter.

tokens.name: caption-line
tokens.usage: 0.70 H: a phrase caption's centre on a full-frame head, dropped below his chin with Vision when needed.

tokens.name: eye-line
tokens.usage: 0.54 H: where the stage holds his eyes.

tokens.name: wall-h
tokens.usage: The stage's visual wall above him, with the caption slot inside it at y 600.

tokens.name: panel-h
tokens.usage: A split's panel slot; its content stays above y 850.

tokens.name: cover-safe-top
tokens.usage: The top of the band a cover's shout must stay in to survive the 3:4 and 1:1 crops.

tokens.name: cover-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: The bottom of that band.

duration.note: Video motion from tools/hf_motion.js (M.dur), then the site's own timings.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Entrances: a rise, a wipe, a card that arrives.

tokens.name: dur-move
tokens.usage: Moves between positions.

tokens.name: dur-exit
tokens.usage: Exits, always shorter than entrances.

tokens.name: dur-land
tokens.usage: The one overshoot of a shot, on its key word.

tokens.name: dur-pop
tokens.usage: A caption box popping in (3 frames).

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Between related elements: never all at once.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Site: the button's square growing, the arrow sliding.

tokens.name: dur-check
tokens.usage: Site: the checkbox's ink square scaling in.

tokens.name: dur-register
tokens.usage: Site: plates sliding into register (rules 140ms after the sage).

tokens.name: dur-afterimage
tokens.usage: Site: the VHS afterimage exit, dither 50, 25, 12 with jolts of -7, 5, -3px.

easing.note: GSAP names for HyperFrames (M.ease), and the site's CSS curve.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Entrances: arrive fast, land soft.

tokens.name: ease-move
tokens.usage: Moves.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Exits.

tokens.name: ease-land
tokens.usage: The one overshoot per shot.

tokens.name: ease-drift
tokens.usage: A held element breathing: a slow push to 1.04, never a dead freeze.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The site's one curve, in CSS, for every transition but the 120ms linear link hover.
